database.description: Database specialist: use for querying and managing relational databases. Can execute SQL queries, insert or update records, and export query results. Choose this agent when the task involves structured data retrieval or database manipulation.

skills.name: Run Query

skills.name: Insert Record

skills.name: Export CSV

translator.description: Translation specialist: use for translating text between languages. Can detect source language, translate documents, and apply glossary rules. Choose this agent when text must be rendered in a different language.

skills.name: Translate Text
skills.description: translate a text snippet from a source language to a target language

skills.name: Detect Language
skills.description: detect the language of a given text

file_archiver.description: File archiving specialist: use for compressing and extracting archive files. Can create ZIP or TAR archives from a set of files, extract an existing archive to a target directory, and list archive contents. Choose this agent when files need to be bundled for transfer or unpacked from a received archive.

skills.name: Create Archive

skills.name: Extract Archive
skills.description: extract the contents of an archive file to a specified directory

skills.name: List Contents
skills.description: list all files and directories inside an archive without extracting

barcode_scanner.description: Barcode and QR code specialist: use for decoding barcodes and QR codes from image files. Can read product EAN/UPC barcodes, decode QR code payloads, and generate new QR codes from text. Choose this agent when an image contains a machine-readable code that needs to be interpreted.

skills.name: Decode Barcode
skills.description: read and return the value encoded in a barcode or QR code image

skills.name: Generate QR Code
skills.description: create a QR code image encoding a given text or URL

currency_converter.description: Currency conversion specialist: use for converting monetary amounts between currencies using live or historical exchange rates. Can look up the current rate for a currency pair, convert a specific amount, and retrieve a rate valid on a past date. Choose this agent when a task requires converting prices or financial figures across currencies.

skills.name: Get Exchange Rate
skills.description: retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies

skills.name: Convert Amount
skills.description: convert a monetary amount from one currency to another using the latest rate

skills.name: Historical Rate
skills.description: retrieve the exchange rate between two currencies on a specified past date

contact_manager.description: Contact management specialist: use for managing an address book of people and organisations. skills.name: Add Contact

skills.name: Lookup Contact
skills.description: search the address book by name and return matching contact details

skills.name: Delete Contact
skills.description: remove a contact entry from the address book by name or ID

time_tracker.description: Time tracking specialist: use for logging and querying work hours against projects or tasks. Can start and stop timers, log manual time entries, and generate per-project time reports. Choose this agent when hours worked need to be recorded or summarised.

skills.name: Start Timer
skills.description: start a running timer for a given project and task label

skills.name: Stop Timer
skills.description: stop the active timer and record the elapsed duration

skills.name: Log Entry
skills.description: manually add a time entry with a start time, duration, and project

invoice_processor.description: Invoice processing specialist: use for parsing and validating invoice documents. Can extract line items, totals, and vendor details from PDF or image invoices. Choose this agent for accounts-payable or billing workflows.

skills.name: Validate Totals
skills.description: verify that line item subtotals match the invoice grand total

code_reviewer.description: Code review specialist: use for static analysis and style checking of source code. Can detect common bugs, enforce naming conventions, and summarize code changes. Choose this agent when source files need to be audited.

skills.name: Lint Code

skills.name: Summarize Diff

travel_booker.description: Travel booking specialist: use for searching and reserving flights, hotels, and rental cars. Can compare prices, apply travel policies, and confirm bookings. Choose this agent for corporate travel planning tasks.

skills.name: Search Flights

skills.name: Reserve Hotel
skills.description: book a hotel room for specified check-in and check-out dates

audio_transcriber.description: Audio transcription specialist: use for converting speech recordings to text. Can handle multiple speakers, timestamps, and noisy audio. Choose this agent when meeting recordings or voice memos need to be transcribed.

skills.description: convert an audio file to a time-stamped text transcript

skills.name: Identify Speakers
skills.description: label transcript segments by detected speaker identity

form_filler.description: Form filling specialist: use for programmatically completing digital forms and surveys. Can map data fields, handle dropdowns, and submit completed forms. Choose this agent when structured input must be entered into a form interface.

skills.name: Submit Form
skills.description: submit a completed form and capture the confirmation response

log_analyzer.description: Log analysis specialist: use for parsing and aggregating application or system logs. Can filter by severity, extract error traces, and compute event frequencies. Choose this agent when diagnosing system issues from log files.

contract_manager.description: Contract management specialist: use for drafting, reviewing, and tracking legal agreements. Can populate contract templates, flag non-standard clauses, and record signature status. Choose this agent for legal or procurement document workflows.

inventory_tracker.description: Inventory tracking specialist: use for monitoring stock levels and recording movements. Can update quantities, generate reorder alerts, and produce stock reports. Choose this agent for warehouse or supply-chain management tasks.

chart_builder.description: Chart building specialist: use for generating data visualizations from tabular data. Can produce bar charts, line graphs, pie charts, and scatter plots in various image formats. Choose this agent when data must be presented visually.

skills.name: Line Chart
skills.description: create a line chart from time-series data

ticket_manager.description: Ticket management specialist: use for creating, updating, and resolving support tickets. Can assign tickets to teams, change priority, and add comments. Choose this agent for help-desk or issue-tracking workflows.

skills.description: open a new support ticket with a description and priority level

skills.name: Update Status
skills.description: change the status or assignee of an existing ticket

package_manager.description: Package management specialist: use for installing, upgrading, and removing software packages in an environment. password_manager.description: Credential management specialist: use for securely storing and retrieving service credentials. Can create new entries, rotate secrets, and audit access logs. Choose this agent when credentials need to be provisioned or looked up programmatically.

meeting_summarizer.description: Meeting summarization specialist: use for distilling meeting transcripts or notes into concise summaries and action-item lists. Can identify decisions, owners, and deadlines. Choose this agent after a meeting transcript has been produced and needs to be actioned.

video_editor.description: Video editing specialist: use for trimming, merging, and transcoding video files. Can cut clips to specified timestamps, concatenate multiple clips, and convert between container formats. Choose this agent when video content needs post-production work.

social_media_poster.description: Social media publishing specialist: use for composing and scheduling posts across social platforms. Can draft captions, attach media, and queue posts for a future time. Choose this agent for marketing or communications workflows that target social channels.

weather_service.description: Weather lookup specialist: use for retrieving current conditions and forecasts for a location. Can return temperature, humidity, wind speed, and multi-day forecasts. Choose this agent when weather data is needed for planning or reporting.

recipe_finder.description: Recipe search specialist: use for finding recipes by ingredients, cuisine, or dietary restriction. Can suggest dishes based on available ingredients and return step-by-step cooking instructions. Choose this agent for meal planning or food-related queries.

fitness_tracker.description: Fitness tracking specialist: use for logging workouts, tracking body metrics, and generating exercise summaries. Can record activities with duration and calories, and produce weekly activity reports. Choose this agent for health and wellness tracking tasks.

spell_checker.description: Spelling and grammar checking specialist: use for proofreading text and correcting language errors. Can identify misspellings, suggest corrections, and flag grammatical issues. Choose this agent when written content needs to be polished before publication.

image_resizer.description: Image transformation specialist: use for resizing, cropping, and converting image files between formats. bookmark_manager.description: Bookmark management specialist: use for organising and retrieving saved URLs. Can add bookmarks with tags, search by keyword, and export bookmark collections. Choose this agent when web references need to be catalogued or retrieved.

notification_sender.description: Push notification specialist: use for sending alert messages to users or devices. Can compose notifications with titles, bodies, and action links, and target specific user groups. Choose this agent when real-time alerts need to be dispatched outside of email.

data_anonymizer.description: Data anonymization specialist: use for masking or removing personally identifiable information from text and datasets. xml_parser.description: XML processing specialist: use for parsing, querying, and transforming XML documents. Can run XPath queries, validate against schemas, and apply XSLT transformations. Choose this agent when structured XML data needs to be extracted or reformatted.

survey_builder.description: Survey creation specialist: use for designing questionnaires and collecting responses. Can build surveys with multiple question types, distribute links, and aggregate results. Choose this agent when structured feedback needs to be gathered from a group.

expense_reporter.description: Expense reporting specialist: use for logging business expenses and generating reimbursement reports. Can categorize receipts, compute totals by category, and produce formatted expense summaries. Choose this agent for finance or travel reimbursement workflows.

backup_manager.description: Backup and restore specialist: use for creating and managing data backups. Can snapshot directories, schedule recurring backups, and restore from a specific backup version. Choose this agent for data protection and disaster recovery tasks.

geolocation_service.description: Geolocation and geocoding specialist: use for converting between street addresses and geographic coordinates. signature_verifier.description: Digital signature verification specialist: use for validating cryptographic signatures on documents and files. task_scheduler.description: Job scheduling specialist: use for creating, listing, and removing scheduled tasks or cron jobs. Can define recurring schedules, set one-time triggers, and monitor job execution history. Choose this agent when automated routines need to be configured.

unit_converter.description: Unit conversion specialist: use for converting measurements between metric, imperial, and other unit systems. Can handle length, weight, volume, temperature, and speed conversions. Choose this agent when numerical values need to be expressed in different units.
